title: 4-storey massing with derived floor plates
prompt: In Rhino, create a 4-storey office massing on a 30m x 18m rectangular footprint at the origin. Ground floor is 4200mm floor-to-floor, upper floors 3600mm. Derive the floor slabs from the massing. Put the massing on layer 'Massing' and let slabs go to the 'Slab' layer. Units are mm.
